label: Microsoft Geometry
description: Paths, combined geometry and clipping
boundary: Type conversion is complete (0 gaps; converted package staged under apps/geometry). Original Geometry boots in a navigation window and runs its radio-select workflow (sample switch, Page.Triggers zoom storyboards, Frame navigation, visibility handshake) through app-level resource dictionaries (grid DrawingBrush entries, gradient entries, retained RadioButton template). Template inflation, tiled brush paint (base-fill fallback), path-boolean combine modes and text wrapping stay documented limits.

label: Microsoft WPF Gallery
description: A broad control gallery from Microsoft
boundary: Type conversion is complete (0 gaps; converted package staged under apps/wpf-gallery, hashes verified). The real gallery boots in the browser: Dashboard to Basic Input to ButtonPage navigation plus the ButtonPage disable-checkbox chain (unchecked to checked flips the sample button enabled to disabled), proven by post-input STATE assertions (benchmarks/results/gallery-state/gallery-state-proof JSON, 0 page errors, no error overlay). Layout GridPage boots with its 3x3 ShowGridLines example parsed (dotted boundary guides painted; benchmarks/gallery_grid_proof.py STATE proof). Layout GroupBoxPage boots (header-with-gap frame, Name/Gender fields, typed Ada lands in NameTextBox STATE; benchmarks/gallery_groupbox_proof.py STATE proof). Text TextBoxPage boots (converted AlphabeticValidationRule blocks Ann3 with HasError, Ada pushes and clears; benchmarks/gallery-textbox-proof JSON STATE proof). Collections ListBoxPage boots with its inline color rows (Blue first-selected) and its ItemsSource-bound font list (5 rows, Courier New selected at index 2; real Segoe UI and Red clicks select with content; benchmarks/gallery-listbox-proof JSON STATE proof). The Fluent theme pack merges through the engine theme fallback (AcrylicBackgroundFillColorDefault and the Default/Accent button BasedOn chains resolve app-wide). Remaining limits: loose-XAML detail pages outside the proven path keep precise boundaries (Interaction.Triggers, MenuItem Click EventSetter, FrameWindow Source, Calendar, DatePicker, RichTextBox); session-memory long-dwell idle acceptance stays open.

label: OxyPlot ExampleBrowser
